name: location.confidence
title: Field: location.confidence
description: Meaning and invariants of the location confidence field.
meaning: Geocoding confidence score for how well the result matches the input text.

invariants.label: caveat
invariants.value: A higher score still does not guarantee the result is the one the user intended.

text: Use this field for ranking and trust, not as a substitute for user confirmation when the address matters.
